title: Exhibition advertising
slide_intent: Teach designers to compare title voices while keeping the exhibition, photograph and format fixed.
strategic_value: Millennium Gallery can lend an exhibition its own period character while keeping the recognizable campaign structure.
demonstration: Two Cecil Beaton landscape adverts repeat the pink dotted panel, black-and-white group portrait, logos and date. The lower treatment introduces a different display face for the exhibition title.
practical_value: Compare how the two title treatments sound beside the historical photograph before selecting the guest face.

content_islands.name: First advertisement
content_islands.spec: Split the landscape strip between a pink title field and the group photograph. Keep the venue at upper left, title and dates beneath, and small credits along the base.

content_islands.name: Alternate typography
content_islands.spec: Repeat the layout and photograph below. Reset the title in the alternate face while keeping the campaign furniture in comparable positions.
